title: fix(channels): retain ingress claims through settlement
body:
## What Problem This Solves

An ingress monitor can retire claim ownership during shutdown while an accepted completion, release or failure write is still pending, allowing a replacement drain to race that settlement.

## User Impact

Shutdown joins already-started settlement writes before releasing claim ownership. If a write fails while the drain still owns the claim, shutdown reports the error and retains custody. Callback grace remains bounded, and standalone drains retain their existing abort/recovery behavior.

Existing databases, config, payloads, dedupe, retention and recovery policy stay unchanged. Updates require no migration or operator action. The maintainer approved the storage execution and settlement work in this stack.

## Why This Change Was Made

Register settlement before calling the write, retain the monitor-owned drain through settlement, and remove finished deliveries before failure handling awaits a write. Reuse the existing drain and monitor lifecycle; add no competing queue or shutdown owner. Deferred handoffs remain tracked even when adoption begins before delivery returns.

The exported drain function gains a backward-compatible optional retention argument and a joined-disposal overload. All existing calls retain their previous default. Monitors use the new path immediately. No schema or config changes are introduced.

This lifecycle change stays together because retirement, settlement tracking and joined disposal enforce one custody contract. The larger diff includes formatter-required indentation around the existing monitor options and shared fixture extraction; it does not add a second implementation.

## Evidence

Provider blacksmith-testbox. On lease `tbx_01m3dm1w1m9666jbqnv23f7wy2`, [run 36207351729](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36207351729), the old monitor fails the peer-recovery negative control in **26.32s**: a peer starts while the first owner's settlement remains pending.

Changed test costs with `pnpm test <file> --maxWorkers=1`: `ingress-drain.ownership.test.ts` **24.67s**, `ingress-monitor.shutdown.test.ts` **7.78s**, `ingress-drain.test.ts` **10.26s**, `ingress-monitor.test.ts` **9.82s** (36 tests). New shutdown tests use controlled promises and fake clocks. The old stop-before-settlement assertion is replaced by commit-before-stop and peer-fencing proof; callback-grace coverage remains. Docs lint passed in **10.95s**.

On lease `tbx_01m3dttmd432sdrxr0qyf12er2`, [run 36213749329](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36213749329), the exact reviewed tree was reconstructed and the real commit hook passed unchanged. SDK export check passes. API diff passes in **346.38s**, digest `a950e2b3`: no entrypoints or exports added/removed; the two drain exports reflect the compatible signature addition, plus 126 reachable declaration hashes. Deslop is clean; two Codex P0–P2 reviews are clean, including the final test replacement. Enforced `openclaw/ci-gate` replaces separate Testbox `check-changed`. Final signed-SMS SIGKILL/replay proof runs after the last slice on merged main.

After rebasing onto the preceding kernel slice, the source range-diff is identical. The four owner test files pass together in **25.39s** on lease `tbx_01m3dttmd432sdrxr0qyf12er2`; doc formatting passes.

## Refreshed Proof and Resolved CI

The maintainer approved the operational-listing adjustment: listings that feed queue decisions will use the shared write broker FIFO. Health and account diagnostics retain the read-only worker. This settlement-custody slice remains patch-identical after rebasing onto the refreshed preceding slice; the discovered listing regressions belong to the final cutover.

At head `94c54f0f42767616f1b44aaf794ce4412a453ef6`, blacksmith-testbox lease `tbx_01m3e808a30trnen7savfd7qj3`, [run 36225250659](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36225250659), verified source hashes and frozen dependencies, then ran:

- `pnpm test src/channels/message/ingress-drain.ownership.test.ts src/channels/message/ingress-monitor.shutdown.test.ts src/channels/message/ingress-drain.test.ts src/channels/message/ingress-monitor.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: **76 tests passed / 28.83s**. Per-file costs from the identical reviewed patch remain above.
- `pnpm plugin-sdk:api:diff --base d8e13e140666fc649acd5da6df1ae1d3efea9343 --head HEAD`: passed in **300.29s**, digest `3e07ab50`, no entrypoints or exports added/removed. The compatible retention argument and joined-disposal overload remain the named API changes.
- `pnpm plugin-sdk:check-exports` and `git diff --check`: passed.

Fresh Codex P0–P2 review is clean; deslop found no changes needed. Main includes the UI import repair `da8149b8ba7d88d76dbe7979986e307a4542e6f0`. Its formerly failing type stripe passes all five graphs on the preceding rebased slice in **132.17s**. The workspace quota-scan repair `a9760fd99f9700efc4f228a02d7680eb25c4b569` is also included and its boundary test passes in **12.29s**. No files in either unrelated owner were changed here.

This PR has no prior native merge submission. Final signed-SMS SIGKILL/replay proof remains scheduled against merged main after the final slice; legacy Telegram import and startup profiling remain documented follow-ups.

## CI Interaction Repaired

The refreshed candidate exposed a monitor idle race in the existing Slack malformed-row replay test. After a claim settled, its handler could leave active state while an existing drain wake still owned the next pump. `waitForIdle()` could return in that interval. It now joins that wake and requires no replacement wake before reporting idle; channel assertions and timers are unchanged.

On the same Testbox lease, the original CI Slack group reproduced **1 failure / 3,136 tests in 142.88s**; the focused file reproduced it in **26.09s**. Clean main `67adcce7e3043601354eacea4444d3361ee729c4` passed all three focused cases in **27.74s**. With the owner fix, the focused file passes in **22.77s**, all **76** core owner tests pass in **12.53s**, and the original **174-file / 3,136-test** group passes in **125.60s**. The comparison uses the original two-worker CI configuration and ordering. No failure was hidden by a retry or weaker assertion.

The full review found the working-tree fix sound; its sole remaining finding was the unstaged index still holding the old code. The fix is staged and its final Codex correction review is clean. The native remote commit hook passed against the exact tested tree; the fix is published at `c5cfec6b77ca86bbd707a9f061444d58a540a59f`. The SDK signatures are unchanged by this implementation-only correction.

## Current Head Proof

After the kernel slice merged, this PR was rebased onto `eaf8d916f7f`; both commits are patch-identical by range-diff. Published head is `e363f2f9f25bbebc44cf88423eb95b25b806f1be`. No source change was made to hide the unexplained AppSDK failure below.

On blacksmith-testbox lease `tbx_01m3ekzp2je1jm0fnkypbj18sg`, [run 36235757385](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36235757385), an isolated checkout verified that exact head and installed frozen dependencies:

- `pnpm test src/channels/message/ingress-drain.ownership.test.ts src/channels/message/ingress-monitor.shutdown.test.ts src/channels/message/ingress-drain.test.ts src/channels/message/ingress-monitor.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: **76 passed / 24.96s**.
- `pnpm test extensions/slack/src/monitor/ingress.relay.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: **3 passed / 13.52s**.
- `pnpm plugin-sdk:api:diff --base eaf8d916f7f --head HEAD`: passed in **259.06s**, digest `38182645`; the same two compatible drain signatures and six reachable declarations changed. SDK exports and `git diff --check` pass.

The prior per-file test costs remain applicable to the identical patch. Deslop needs no edits; the existing clean Codex reviews cover both unchanged commits. CI run `36238279284` is attached to this exact head. The earlier failure remains recorded below; a recurrence requires further owner investigation.

## Current CI Investigation

Exact-head CI run `36230059592` at `c5cfec6b77ca86bbd707a9f061444d58a540a59f` stopped after the AppSDK composed-resources test reported `AgentDatabaseRegistryChangedError`. The relevant registry, artifact-read, and fixture sources are unchanged by this PR. That alone does not establish that the failure is unrelated.

On blacksmith-testbox lease `tbx_01m3eet19r9pn73v0a6c1twhcp`, [run 36231222685](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36231222685), the original ordered 42-file infra, 59-file Gateway, and 27-file state groups were replayed through `node --import tsx scripts/ci-run-node-test-shard.mts` with the original plan and two-worker policy. Clean main `0042f8a570d48f01e7f4f667e3e4833caa68d80a` passed in **407.99s**; the exact failed candidate passed in **387.41s**. These passing replays are reproduction results, not a claimed fix.

A temporary observation-only registry trace on clean main captured one recoverable discovery invalidation during `artifacts.list`: registration admission for the custom AppSDK session store replaced the same-path registry generation. That 27-file group still passed all **96 tests / 149.89s**. The trace was removed after the run. The original hosted failure remains unexplained; no registry guard, assertion, retry, or timeout was weakened, and hosted CI has not been rerun merely to obtain green.
